title: MIDI to audio
description: Plays MIDI notes (or a MIDI sequence) through a SoundFont and gives audio, using only integer calculations so that the result is the same on every machine. It needs a SoundFont file.

parameters.name: file
parameters.doc: SoundFont 2 file or installed GM pack.

parameters.name: bank
parameters.doc: source or a zero-based SoundFont bank number (0-16383).

parameters.name: program
parameters.doc: source or a zero-based GM program number (0-127).

parameters.name: limiter
parameters.doc: Integer soft limiter at the PCM output; off keeps hard clipping.

parameters.name: track
parameters.doc: all or a zero-based sequence track number.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

needs: A SoundFont 2 (.sf2) file (parameter file; the default is the MuseScore General pack).
